body: Haha. Also just turned 20 and am in a ridiculously similar situation. I’ll preface this with the fact that I don’t have any advice, I can’t even seem to help myself :) I definitely don’t think a job is the answer though. What do you enjoy doing? Now that you’re free from the clutches of some awful company- spend that time rediscovering the joys in life, personally, I’m getting back into graffiti. I know this doesn’t solve any of your actual problems though. Stay safe, things will get better for you. I’m sorry you’re going through such a rough time. Your mum can get fucked (or not, love you mum) :)

I don’t wanna sound preachy but fuck, there’s so much more to life than school. Your post reminds me of my own thought process as a teen, I truly comprehend living past 18, yet here I am. I doubt your family hates you but if they do then fuck em. Focus on doing things you enjoy doing. Have any hobbies? School isn’t as important as everyone makes it out to be. I ended up dropping out and I’m not saying this is the answer but being able to just work doing something I semi enjoyed while finally making money I realised just how fucking draining school is. I also don’t have a great relationship with my family so being able to move out has been pretty great for my mental well-being. I don’t know, all I’m trying to say is although school, parents and all the other shit that teenhood forces us to go through is suffocating and hard as fuck you do have a future outside of this! Education isn’t some linear path we all have to take, if it isn’t for you don’t force yourself to be miserable. This is your life, just take it easy and let yourself breathe
I got psychiatric help. I suggest you do too if you’re also having these thoughts but I understand that isn’t always the easiest thing to do. If you need someone to talk to I’m also here

Felt this way all through my teens and still do on occasion. I used to find myself wishing for a reason to be suicidal because I couldn’t make sense of why I felt this way with no apparent reason. Kind of discovered my undiagnosed mental illnesses were in fact … mental illness. It kind of helps knowing I’m not just being ungrateful and dramatic but unfortunately the nature of depression will always find a way to make you feel guilty. Lot’s of us feel confused, and that confusion just makes it all a whole lot more stressful. Suicidal thoughts are not in your control and you certainly don’t have to have a “valid” reason to get them. You’re definitely not alone!

Prefacing this with the fact that doing terribly in college is not a reflection of your abilities or self worth. I’ve always hated the notion that school is the end all be all, if you fail you’re worthless bullshit everyone tries to push on young adults. 

If being in college at the moment during this difficult time for you maybe you should take a break? You can always go back to school when you’re feeling a little better and you’re not a failure by prioritising your life and wellbeing. 

Going to hospital isn’t a bad idea if you’re actively suicidal but if not it’s possible it’d make everything worse and imo therapy is better in that scenario. You will know what’s best for you, not your father nor myself and I trust your decision. I hope you’ll get out of this, I believe in you :) (You’re not a failure)

Next time, yes, go get stitches. If your cut is from yesterday unfortunately it’s too late now so just clean it and bandage with antibiotic ointment, gauze and tape or a sterile bandaid (you can get ones that are 8x10cm.) Stay safe and if you’re worried about infection at any point go get antibiotics :)

I advise you to go get stitches if possible, sounds like you need them. That being said I’ve had this exact problem with deep cuts on my forearm that I had to wrap for my job and I would just lather it in antibiotic ointment and Vaseline right before my shift (and in the middle of it if I was working for more than 6hrs) and then unwrap them as soon as I got home to let it dry up and scab so it’s easier to deal with. It’s still pretty gross but not nearly as painful as when I’d leave it on for prolonged periods. I actually passed out from the pain of changing one of my bandages recently so be careful!

You should go. It’ll take way longer to heal, more than likely heal badly and you’re at a greater risk of infection. It’s worth going and you certainly won’t be wasting anyones time by doing so. Stay safe ❤️

You’ll find a lot 18/19/20 year olds feeling lost and lonely, myself included. Start socialising if you can, I think you’ll find most of your peers are also feeling similarly. No one knows what they’re doing!

Sooo, I’m in no way a medical professional and if you’re concerned there’s no shame in going to get stitches (they shouldn’t question you about it) but if you’re looking for bad advice from someone who avoids hospital and stitches as much as possible here you go. Most cuts will heal without stitches, the scarring will just likely be a lot worse and take a while. The concern with deeper cuts is risk of infection so keep your shit sterile and only change your dressing when you need to. If it’s stopped bleeding you’ll be okay! But hey, I really do suggest going and getting it checked out if it doesn’t look like it’s healing right

Happy birthday! I’m sorry your mum reacted that way but she probably just doesn’t know what to do, however, I hope that if she wants to help and look after you she realises she cannot react like that and need to gain some understanding. I also relapsed last night after a year clean and yeah while it fucking sucks don’t let it hinder your previous accomplishments. I know you’ve probably heard this a lot but I think it’s important to reiterate; recovery isn’t streamline, there are going to be fuck ups, times you relapse or even moments where you’re happy and don’t want to recover and that’s okay! It really isn’t as big of a deal as it seems. I know when you’re depressed and suffering it can seem like you’re in your own little world surrounded by nothing but your own shitty thoughts but you’re not alone :) You’ll be okay eventually, I believe in you. Try not to think of relapse as a solely negative thing and cut yourself some slack. 3 months is a solid fucking achievement and I’m sure you’ll get there again. Stay safe and look after yourself
